ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
// Traverse every chapter section, as in Keiyoushi's parseChapterList().
var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result), baseUrl);
var state = String(java.get('VIEWSTATE') || '');
var sections = Array.from(doc.select('[id^=chapter-list-]'));
if (state.length > 5) {
    var hidden = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parseBodyFragment(state, baseUrl);
    var extra = Array.from(hidden.select('[id^=chapter-list-]'));
    // The hidden R18 list substitutes for a placeholder rather than creating duplicates.
    for (var h = 0; h < extra.length; h++) {
        var id = extra[h].id();
        var found = false;
        for (var e = 0; e < sections.length; e++) {
            if (sections[e].id() == id) {
                sections[e] = extra[h];
                found = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!found) sections.push(extra[h]);
    }
}
// Compatibility fallback for layouts that use only the .chapter-list class.
if (sections.length === 0) {
    sections = Array.from(doc.select('.chapter-list'));
    if (state.length > 5) {
        var hiddenSections = Array.from(org.jsoup.Jsoup.parseBodyFragment(state, baseUrl).select('.chapter-list'));
        if (hiddenSections.length > 0) sections = hiddenSections;
    }
}
var latestHref = String(doc.select('div.book-detail > ul.detail-list > li.status > span > a.blue').attr('href'));
var latestDateElement = doc.select('div.book-detail > ul.detail-list > li.status > span > span.red').last();
var latestDate = latestDateElement ? String(latestDateElement.text()) : '';
var data = [];
var seen = {};
for (var s = 0; s < sections.length; s++) {
    var pageLists = Array.from(sections[s].select('ul')).reverse();
    for (var p = 0; p < pageLists.length; p++) {
        var anchors = Array.from(pageLists[p].select('li > a.status0'));
        if (anchors.length === 0) anchors = Array.from(pageLists[p].select('li > a'));
        for (var i = 0; i < anchors.length; i++) {
            var a = anchors[i];
            var href = String(a.attr('href'));
            if (!href || seen[href]) continue;
            seen[href] = true;
            var rawTitle = String(a.attr('title'));
            if (!rawTitle) rawTitle = String(a.select('span').text() || a.text());
            var pages = String(a.text()).match(/(\d+p)\s*$/);
            var title = rawTitle + (pages && rawTitle.indexOf('(' + pages[1] + ')') < 0 ? '(' + pages[1] + ')' : '');
            if (Get('settle') == true) {
                title = title.replace(/[-_]/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            }
            if (latestDate && latestHref && href == latestHref) title += '〔' + latestDate + '〕';
            data.push({title:title, link:href.indexOf('http') === 0 ? href : Get('url') + href});
        }
    }
}
// Legado chapter indices follow the returned array order.
// The upstream site lists newest chapters first; emit oldest to newest.
data.reverse();
Put(JSON.stringify(data));
</js>
